title: ever LUMINE|Sequin Sleeveless Fringe Cocktail Dress
descriptionHtml:
Inspired by 1920s elegance, this sequin fringe cocktail dress brings movement and sparkle to every step. The cap sleeves add a soft, feminine touch, while layered fringes create dynamic flow when you dance. Ideal for cocktail parties, Great Gatsby events, formal dinners, or any evening that calls for vintage sophistication.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
